_comment: Configuration of the validated classical-GR run. All derived quantities are computed from constants at run time.
integrator: Dormand–Prince RK5(4), adaptive, FSAL, PI step control; independent variable ln r inside (tau outside when needed)
notes: Default scenario: radial free fall from rest at infinity (E = 1, L = 0), started numerically at r0 = 100 r_s. Validated trajectory stops at r_QG where K = 1/l_P^4.
